name: agent-suite-maintainer
body: A person or agent who owns the DISTRIBUTION BOUNDARY of the apg opencode agent suite: which agents `apg init` installs into `~/.config/opencode/agents/` from `opencode-suite/agents/**`, and which each repo generates for itself with the `agent-builder`. Their interest is an honest boundary: every generated option the suite distributes is one it supports (the optional `coordinator` is dead), and repo-agnostic agents (`implementation-phase-reviewer`) are distributed rather than regenerated per repo. The boundary is product source — the distributed templates are embedded in the binary via `include_str!` — and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts outside the hand-edit path of a boundary change.
